# MiniSeek Engineering All-Hands
## Date: August 29, 2026 | 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM PDT
## Location: Conference Room A (Hybrid - Zoom ID: 991-4482-1100)

### Attendees
- VP of Engineering (Chair)
- Lead Engineer
- Senior Security Architect
- DevOps Lead
- QA Lead
- Product Manager
- UX Designer
- 3 Junior Engineers (remote)

---

### Agenda

#### 1. Q3 Sprint Retrospective (10:00 - 10:30)

The team completed 47 of 52 planned story points (90.4% velocity).
Carryover items:
- JIRA-1892: Refactor ingestion pipeline error handling
- JIRA-1905: Add integration tests for PDF parser edge cases
- JIRA-1911: Update API documentation for v2.1 release
- JIRA-1918: Resolve flaky test in CI pipeline (intermittent timeout)
- JIRA-1924: Performance profiling on M1 hardware

Key achievements:
- Phase 1 (File Organizer) shipped to production with 48/48 tests passing
- Phase 2 (Expense Synthesizer) completed with 138/138 tests
- Zero critical bugs reported in production over the quarter
- Reduced CI pipeline time from 4.2 minutes to 0.16 seconds

#### 2. Infrastructure Update (10:30 - 11:00)

DevOps Lead presented the current cloud infrastructure status:
- AWS monthly spend trending at $92.50/month (under $100 target)
- Database migration from RDS PostgreSQL 14 to 15.4 completed
- S3 lifecycle policies reduced storage costs by 23%
- CloudWatch alerting configured for all production services
- Uptime over Q3: 99.97% (13 minutes unplanned downtime on Aug 14)

Action Items:
- [ ] Evaluate moving to reserved instances for EC2 (potential 40% savings)
- [ ] Set up cross-region backup for RDS
- [ ] Implement S3 Intelligent-Tiering for infrequently accessed data
- [ ] Review CloudTrail logs for security audit

#### 3. Security Review Findings (11:00 - 11:30)

Sarah Chen from Apex Technical Consulting presented the Phase II security audit results:
- 0 critical vulnerabilities found
- 2 medium findings (both remediated):
  * Finding M-001: Session token rotation interval too long (fixed: 15min)
  * Finding M-002: Missing rate limiting on API endpoint (fixed: 100 req/min)
- 4 low/informational findings:
  * L-001: HTTP security headers could be strengthened
  * L-002: Verbose error messages in development mode
  * L-003: Dependency version pinning inconsistencies
  * L-004: Logging format standardization recommended
- SOC 2 Type II preparation is on track for Q4 audit
- Penetration testing report delivered (no successful exploits)

#### 4. Product Roadmap Q4 Preview (11:30 - 12:00)

Product Manager outlined Q4 priorities:
1. MiniSeek Evaluation & Experimentation Suite
   - Context budget benchmarks (EXP-001 through EXP-005)
   - Model comparison framework
   - Automated regression testing
2. Developer Experience Improvements
   - CLI tool enhancements
   - Better error messages and diagnostics
   - Documentation site refresh
3. Performance Optimization
   - Target: sub-1-second per-document processing
   - Memory footprint reduction for 8GB M1 Macs
   - Batch processing pipeline

No budget or purchase decisions were made in this meeting.
No financial transactions were authorized or discussed.
